permissions.description: Customer, internal and marketing-event engagement requests

actions.description: Raise a customer, internal or marketing-event engagement
See the engagement list and its details
Complete, reopen, cancel or otherwise change an engagement's status

permissions.description: The internal engagement and marketing event approval queue

actions.description: See engagements and events pending approval
Correct a pending engagement or event and approve it

permissions.description: Consultant allocations to engagements and team default allocations

actions.description: Allocate a staff or partner consultant to an engagement
Move an allocation through its clearance lifecycle
Add, edit, remove or bulk-upload a team's default allocations
Add, edit or delete allocation types
Add, edit or delete partner consultants
See the app's roles and the privileges each holds

groups.name: Requesters
groups.description: Engagement and delivery staff who raise engagement requests

groups.name: Approvers
groups.description: People who approve internal engagements and marketing events

groups.name: AllocationManagers
groups.description: People who staff engagements and clear consultant allocations

groups.name: TeamManagers
groups.description: Team leads who keep their team's default allocations current

groups.name: FinanceAnalysts
groups.description: Finance staff who read the dashboard and the consultant allocations report

groups.name: AllocationAdmins
groups.description: Administrators of allocation types, partner consultants and access roles

roles.name: Requester
roles.description: Raises customer and internal engagement requests, edits them, and tracks, completes or cancels them.

roles.name: Approver
roles.description: Approves pending internal engagements and marketing events, correcting them first when needed.

roles.name: AllocationManager
roles.description: Allocates consultants to engagements and takes each allocation through clearance.

roles.name: TeamManager
roles.description: Keeps a team's default allocations current, one at a time or in bulk.

roles.name: FinanceAnalyst
roles.description: Reads the dashboard and the consultant allocations report.

roles.name: Administrator
roles.description: Maintains access roles, partner consultants and allocation types.
